description: This file contains the implementation of the CanvasController class, which manages WebView interactions for rendering and capturing snapshots of a canvas in an Android application. It includes methods for navigating URLs, capturing bitmaps, resizing images, and communicating with JavaScript in the WebView. It also handles debug status display and state management of the canvas.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: Manages WebView-based canvas rendering, capturing, and state management, including snapshot functionalities and debug status controls.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebView to the controller, sets up event handlers, and loads initial content.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the WebView from the controller to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to a specified URL.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL is the default scaffold URL.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Invoked when a page load in the WebView finishes, to update UI overlays.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON state representing the home canvas.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the WebView context and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a WebView snapshot as a PNG image encoded in Base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a WebView snapshot in the specified image format and quality, returning a Base64 string.
